Photos: Koos Groenewold en Jan Willem Schouten

In 2026, Marien and Joos Poppe removed weeds within the row using an Andela Robot Weeder and between the rows using an Electro Weeder. The combination of the two machines works well, provided there are enough workable days. On July 24, there are quite a few large weeds in the onions at Poppe Landbouw in the Noordoostpolder, the Netherlands. Most of them are in the tramlines between the beds, and this is mainly knotweed.
